Roboctopi — FTC Team 14496

We are a student-led robotics team competing in the FIRST Tech Challenge, proudly representing San Diego since 2019.

About Our Team

Roboctopi brings together students passionate about engineering, coding, and teamwork to design, build, and program a competitive robot each season.

Our Mission

We aim to inspire younger students in our district to pursue STEM through outreach events and demonstrations.
